newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs steady to lower amid crude slump.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs steady to lower amid crude slump.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were stable to only slightly lower Thursday despite a sharp downturn in crude future prices, players said.
But deals were few as many traders took an early exit for the long Fourth of July weekend.
Mont Belvieu propane was stable with Wednesday values, with material offered at 35.0 cents a gallon. Conway material was sold for 35.5 cents, also stable.
Belvieu natural gasoline was sold for 43.5 cents, unchanged from Wednesday, traders said.
